h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kozhikode

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kozhikode

items.pText: Families in Kozhikode spend their evenings outdoors, along the beach promenade and in neighbourhood grounds, so public play spaces here see steady use. The city sits on the Malabar coast and takes the full force of the south-west monsoon each year. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 950 km north, and delivers it to Kozhikode by road.

Our buyers here include the municipal corporation's parks, schools, housing projects and hotels. Share the space, the age group and photos, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. After you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture and dispatch it, and our team or a dealer installs it on site.

richText.heading: Sand, salt and surfaces near the beach

c: Many seaside play areas sit directly on sand. Sand cushions falls when it is loose and deep, but it compacts after rain, hides litter and spreads into nearby walkways. Rubber flooring on a firm, drained base needs less upkeep and stays usable after a heavy shower.

items.q: Is sand a good surface under playground equipment near the beach?
items.a: Loose, deep sand cushions falls, but it compacts after rain and needs regular raking. Rubber flooring on a drained base usually needs less maintenance for a busy public space.

items.q: Do you supply municipal parks in Kozhikode?
items.a: Yes. We supply parks, schools, societies and hotels, with equipment made in Vasai and installed by our team or a regional dealer. We start with a layout drawing for approval.

items.q: How often should coastal equipment be cleaned?
items.a: A fresh-water rinse every few weeks and a check of bolts after the monsoon. Report any damage to our after-sales team so parts can be assessed under warranty.
